items.scene: 你在广交会展位前问供应商

answers.en: Can you give me a quote?
What's your price for this?
Could you send me pricing?
answers.note: send me pricing 是让对方发价格表。

answers.en: Does this price include shipping?
Is shipping included?
Is that the landed price?
answers.note: landed price 是到岸价，含运费和杂费。

answers.en: How long is the quote good for?
answers.note: good for 指有效期，很口语。

answers.en: When does this price expire?
answers.zh: 这个价格什么时候到期？

answers.en: Can you hold this price for a month?
answers.note: 直接问能不能保价一个月。
answers.zh: 这个价能保留一个月吗？

answers.en: Is there a discount for a thousand units?
answers.note: units 是件数，比 pieces 正式一点。

answers.en: What's the price if we order a thousand?
Can you do better on a larger order?
answers.note: do better 是再便宜点，语气委婉。

items.zh: 你们的最小起订量是多少？

answers.en: What's your minimum order?
answers.note: minimum order 是最小起订量，最常用。

answers.en: What's the MOQ?
answers.note: MOQ 是行业缩写，供应商都懂。

answers.en: How small an order can you take?
answers.note: 更口语，问最小能接多小的单。

answers.en: Can you quote FOB?
answers.note: FOB 是离岸价，外贸常用术语。

answers.en: Do you have an FOB price?
answers.note: 问有没有 FOB 价格。

answers.en: Can you send both FOB and CIF?
answers.note: CIF 是到岸价，两个一起要方便比较。
answers.zh: 能 FOB 和 CIF 都报一下吗？

answers.en: Does this price include tax?
Is tax included?
Is tax extra?

items.zh: 能发一份正式报价单吗？
items.scene: 你在微信上跟供应商说

answers.en: Can you send me a formal quote?
answers.note: formal quote 是正式报价单。

answers.en: Could you put that in a quote sheet?
Can you email me the quotation?
answers.zh: 能把报价单邮件发我吗？

answers.en: Why is it higher than last time?
answers.note: higher 指价格高了，语气中性。

answers.en: This is more than we paid before.
What changed on the price?
answers.note: 问价格变动的原因，不直接指责。

items.scene: 你在展位前跟供应商谈

answers.en: Can you do a little better?
answers.note: do better 是再让点价，很口语。

answers.en: Is there any room on the price?
answers.note: room on the price 是有没有降价空间。

answers.en: Can you meet us halfway?
answers.note: meet us halfway 是各让一步，谈价时很常用。

items.zh: 这个价格能保持到什么时候？

answers.en: How long can you hold this price?
Is this price firm for the quarter?
answers.note: firm 是固定价，quarter 是一个季度。
answers.zh: 这个价这一季度固定吗？

answers.en: Will the price change next month?
Is the sample fee refundable?
Do you refund the sample cost with the order?
answers.note: 问下单后能不能退样品费。

answers.en: Can the sample fee go toward the order?
How long does a sample take?
When can I get the sample?
answers.note: 问什么时候能拿到样品。

answers.en: What's your sample lead time?
answers.note: lead time 是交期，行业常用。

answers.en: Can you send a sample first?
Could you ship one sample to us?
answers.note: ship 是寄，one sample 说清数量。
answers.zh: 能给我们寄一个样品吗？

answers.en: Can we get a sample before we order?
answers.note: 说明下单前要先看样品。
answers.zh: 下单前能先拿个样品吗？

answers.en: Can the sample be shipped collect?
Can we pay the shipping on delivery?
answers.note: pay on delivery 是货到付款。

answers.en: Do you cover the sample shipping?
answers.note: cover 是承担，问对方出不出运费。

answers.en: Can you make this color?
Is this color available?
Can you match this color?

items.zh: 能按我们的 logo 做吗？

answers.en: Can you put our logo on it?
answers.zh: 能印我们的 logo 吗？

answers.en: Can you print our logo?
Is custom branding possible?
answers.note: custom branding 是定制品牌标识，正式。

answers.en: Can you change the size?
Can we adjust the dimensions?
Can you make it a bit smaller?

items.zh: 这个材质有别的选择吗？

answers.en: Are there other materials?
Do you have this in a different material?
answers.note: in a different material 更具体。

answers.en: What else can it be made of?
Can you provide a test report?
Do you have test results for this?
Can you send the certification?

items.zh: 包装能按我们的要求做吗？

answers.en: Can you pack it the way we need?
answers.note: pack 是包装，the way we need 是按我们的要求。
answers.zh: 能按我们的要求包装吗？

answers.en: Can you use our packaging?
answers.note: our packaging 指我们提供的包装。

answers.en: Can you follow our packing instructions?
answers.zh: 能按我们的包装说明来吗？

answers.en: Can you do custom packaging?
Can we design the box?
answers.note: 问盒子能不能自己设计。

answers.en: Is there a minimum for custom boxes?
answers.note: 问定制盒子有没有起订量。

answers.en: Do you keep this in stock?
answers.note: keep in stock 是常备库存，问是不是常年有货。

answers.en: Is this available now?
Can you ship from stock?
answers.note: ship from stock 是从现货发。

answers.en: Can you send me your catalog?
answers.note: catalog 是产品目录，美式拼写。

answers.en: Could you email the product list?
answers.zh: 能把产品清单邮件发我吗？

answers.en: Do you have a PDF catalog?
Do you have anything new?
What's new this year?
Can you show me your latest models?

items.zh: 这个型号和上一代有什么区别？

answers.en: What's different from the last model?
How is this better than the old one?
What did you change in this version?
Can we do a video tour of the factory?
Can you show me the factory on video?
answers.zh: 能视频带我看下工厂吗？

answers.en: Could we do a video call from the workshop?
What's the lead time?
answers.note: lead time 是交期，行业标准说法。

answers.en: How long does production take?
When can you ship?
Can you deliver earlier?
Can you move the delivery up?
Is there any way to speed this up?
answers.note: speed up 是加快，语气委婉。

items.scene: 你在微信上问工厂跟单

answers.en: When will this batch be ready?
When can we pick up this order?
What's the completion date?
Can you ship in batches?
Can we split the shipment?
answers.note: split the shipment 是拆成几批。

answers.en: Can you send half now and half later?
answers.note: 说清一半现在一半以后。
answers.zh: 能先发一半、后发一半吗？

answers.en: Can we add to the order?
answers.note: add to the order 是在订单上加。

answers.en: Can we increase the quantity?
Is it too late to add more?
answers.note: 问现在加还来不来得及。

items.zh: 能改一下订单的颜色吗？

answers.en: Can we change the color on the order?
Can you switch the color for us?
Is the order still open for changes?
Is the order confirmed?
Did you get our order?
Can you confirm the order?
Can you send an order confirmation?
answers.note: order confirmation 是订单确认单。

answers.en: Could you confirm the order in writing?
Can you send the PO details back?
answers.note: PO 是采购订单，让对方回传明细。

items.scene: 你在微信上问工厂跟单

answers.en: Where are we on production?
How far along is the order?
answers.note: how far along 是进展到哪。

answers.en: What stage are we at?

items.zh: 能拍个生产进度视频吗？

answers.en: Can you send a video of the production line?
answers.zh: 能拍个生产线的视频吗？

answers.en: Can you shoot a quick video of the progress?
answers.note: shoot a video 是拍视频，美式口语。
answers.zh: 能拍个简短的进度视频吗？

answers.en: Could you send a quick video update?
answers.zh: 能发个简短的视频进度吗？

answers.en: Will the delivery be late?
Are we still on schedule?
Is there any risk of a delay?
answers.note: 更委婉，问有没有延误风险。

items.scene: 你在电话里跟供应商确认

answers.en: Can you guarantee the date?
Can you commit to that date?
Are you sure you can make it?
answers.note: 更口语，问对方有没有把握。

answers.en: Can you lower the minimum?
answers.note: lower the minimum 是降低起订量。

answers.en: Can we start with a smaller order?
Is the MOQ flexible?
answers.note: flexible 是灵活，问起订量能不能谈。

answers.en: Can you hold the stock until the end of the month?
Can you reserve it for us?
Can you keep it on hold for two weeks?
answers.note: on hold 是暂留，说清时间。

answers.en: Can you make half first?
Can you start with half the order?
Can we produce the first half now?
What payment terms do you offer?
How do you usually get paid?
What are the payment options?

items.scene: 你在电话里跟供应商谈

answers.en: Can we pay a deposit first?
Can we start with a down payment?
answers.note: down payment 是首付/预付款。

answers.en: Is a deposit enough to start?
When is the balance due?
When do we pay the rest?
answers.note: the rest 是剩下的钱，更口语。

answers.en: Do we pay the balance before shipping?
Can you accept a letter of credit?
answers.note: letter of credit 是信用证，缩写 L/C。

answers.en: Do you take L/C?
answers.note: L/C 是信用证缩写，外贸常用。

answers.en: Can we pay by L/C?
Can you prepare a commercial invoice?
Can you send the commercial invoice?
Do you provide an invoice for customs?
answers.zh: 能提供报关用的发票吗？

answers.en: Whose name should the invoice be under?
answers.note: under 指发票开在谁名下。

answers.en: Can you bill it to our company?
answers.note: bill it to 是开给某公司。

answers.en: Should the invoice be in our company name?
Could you send a link to pay?
answers.note: link to pay 是付款链接，口语自然。

answers.en: Can you send an invoice with a link?
answers.zh: 能发个带链接的账单吗？

answers.en: Where do I pay online?
How soon do you ship after payment?
When will it ship once we pay?
answers.note: once we pay 是付款之后。
answers.zh: 我们付款后什么时候发？

answers.en: How long after payment do you dispatch?
Can you take RMB?
answers.note: RMB 是人民币，外贸常用。

answers.en: Can we pay in yuan?
Do you accept Chinese currency?
Can I pay through PayPal?
Do you take PayPal?
Is PayPal okay for the deposit?
Who covers the transfer fee?
answers.note: cover 是承担，transfer fee 是汇款手续费。

answers.en: Are bank charges included?
Do we need to cover the wire fee?

items.scene: 你在电话里跟货代确认

answers.en: Should we ship by sea or air?
Sea or air freight?
Which is cheaper, sea or air?
What's the shipping charge?
answers.note: shipping charge 是运费，邮件常用。

answers.en: What's the freight cost?
answers.note: freight cost 是运费，稍正式。

answers.en: Can you quote the freight?
Can you send me the tracking number?
Do you have a tracking number?
Where can I track it?
Has the shipment arrived at the port?
Is it at the port yet?
When does it reach the port?
Can you book the space?
Can you handle the booking?
answers.note: handle the booking 是负责订舱。

answers.en: Do you book freight for us?
answers.note: 问对方是不是帮我们订。

answers.en: What documents do we need for customs?
answers.note: documents for customs 是清关文件。

answers.en: What do you need for clearance?
Can you send the customs paperwork?
Can you deliver to our warehouse?
Can you drop it at the warehouse?
answers.note: drop it 是送到，很口语。

answers.en: Is warehouse delivery included?
Can you ship to an Amazon warehouse?
Can you deliver to FBA?
answers.note: FBA 是亚马逊代发货，卖家常用。

answers.en: Do you handle Amazon FBA shipping?
answers.note: 问对方做不做 FBA 发货。
answers.zh: 你们做 FBA 发货吗？

answers.en: Is this shipping by courier?
Are we sending this by express?
Can it go by courier?
Can you combine the shipments?
Can you ship them together?
Can we put both orders in one shipment?
Can we use our own forwarder?
Can we nominate a forwarder?
Do you work with our forwarder?
answers.note: 问对方配不配合我们的货代。
answers.zh: 你们能跟我们的货代对接吗？

items.scene: 你收到货后打电话给供应商

answers.en: There's a quality problem with this batch.
This batch didn't pass our check.
answers.note: pass our check 是没通过我们的检查。
answers.zh: 这批没通过我们的检查。

answers.en: The quality isn't what we agreed.
answers.zh: 质量跟我们说好的不一样。

answers.en: The color doesn't match the sample.
answers.note: match the sample 是和样品一致。

answers.en: This is a different shade.
The color is off.
answers.note: be off 是不对，很口语。

items.scene: 你量了货后打电话给供应商

answers.en: The size is wrong.
These don't match the specs.
The dimensions are off.
answers.note: dimensions 是尺寸，off 是不对。

items.scene: 你点完货后打电话给供应商

answers.en: We're short on the quantity.
answers.note: be short on 是数量不够。

answers.en: The count is off.
answers.note: count 是点数，off 是对不上。

answers.en: We received fewer than ordered.

items.scene: 你拆箱后拍照发给供应商

answers.en: Some units arrived damaged.
There's damage in the shipment.
Several pieces are broken.
Can you replace them?
Can we get replacements?
Can you send new ones?
answers.note: 更口语，问能不能发新的。

answers.en: Can we get a refund?
Can you refund us?
What about a refund?
Can you ship the missing ones?
Can you make up the shortfall?
answers.note: make up the shortfall 是补足差额。

answers.en: Can you send the rest?
answers.note: 更口语，问剩下的能不能发。

answers.en: Can you send someone to check?
Can your engineer come and look?
answers.zh: 你们技术员能来看看吗？

answers.en: Can you inspect it on site?

items.scene: 你在电话里跟供应商复盘

answers.en: How do we avoid this next time?
What can we do differently?
How do we make sure it doesn't happen again?
Can you send a quality report?
Can you write up what went wrong?
Can you give us a report?

items.scene: 你在电话里跟供应商谈

answers.en: Can you discount this batch?
Can we get a discount on this lot?
answers.zh: 这批能给我们个折扣吗？

answers.en: Can you take something off the price?
answers.note: take something off 是减一点。

items.scene: 你在展馆里打电话给参展商

answers.en: Where's your booth?
Which hall are you in?
What's your booth number?
Can we set up a time to talk?
answers.note: set up a time 是约时间。

answers.en: Can we schedule a chat?
When are you free to meet?
Can we visit your factory tomorrow?
Are you free for a factory visit tomorrow?
Can we come by the factory?
Can you arrange a pickup?
Can you send a car?
Could someone pick us up?
Can we see the production line?
Can we tour the workshop?
Is a line visit possible?
Can we meet your manager?
Is your manager available?
Could we talk to the person in charge?
answers.note: the person in charge 是负责人。

answers.en: Can you bring samples?
Will you have samples with you?
Can you bring a sample to the meeting?
Can you send the materials after the show?
Can you email the details?
answers.zh: 能把详细资料邮件发我吗？

answers.en: Will you send the catalog after the fair?
Can we set up a video call?
Can we do a Zoom call?
answers.note: Zoom 常用作视频会议代称。

answers.en: Are you free for a video meeting?
Can you come to our office?
Can you visit us?
Would you be able to come by?
answers.note: come by 是过来，更客气。

items.scene: 你在展会结束后问客户

answers.en: Would you like to grab dinner?
answers.note: grab dinner 是随便吃个饭，轻松。

answers.en: Are you free for dinner tonight?
Can we take you to dinner?
answers.note: take you to dinner 是做东请客。

answers.en: Do you have any dietary restrictions?
answers.note: dietary restrictions 是饮食禁忌，正式。

answers.en: Any foods to avoid?
answers.note: avoid 是避免，问有没有不能吃的。

answers.en: Any allergies we should know about?
Could you reserve a private room for us?
Can you book a private room?
Is there a private room available?
I'll get the check.
answers.note: get the check 是买单，美式。

answers.en: Let me take care of it.
This one's on me.
answers.note: on me 是我请客，很口语。

answers.en: What local dishes do you recommend?
What's the house specialty?
Any local specialties?
Can you arrange airport pickup?
Can you pick us up at the airport?
Can you send a car to the airport?
Is the hotel booked?
Did you book the hotel?
Do we have a hotel yet?

items.scene: 你在酒店大堂问同行的客户

answers.en: What time do we leave tomorrow?
When do we head out tomorrow?
How early do we start tomorrow?

items.scene: 你在展会上问海外客户

answers.en: Do you have an agent in China?
Who's your agent in China?
Do you work through a local agent?
answers.note: 问是不是通过本地代理做。

items.scene: 你在电话里问贸易公司

answers.en: Can we work directly with the factory?
answers.note: work directly with 是直接对接。

answers.en: Can we talk to the factory directly?
Do we have to go through you?
answers.note: go through you 是必须经过你，语气直接。

answers.en: Can we talk on WeChat?
Can we do this over WeChat?
answers.note: over WeChat 是通过微信，自然。

answers.en: Is WeChat okay for you?

items.scene: 你在邮件里问海外客户

answers.en: We're in different time zones. Can we set a time?
answers.note: time zones 是时区，说清原因。
answers.zh: 我们有时差，能约个时间吗？

answers.en: What time works for you with the time difference?
answers.note: work for you 是对你方便。

answers.en: Can we pick a time that works for both of us?
answers.zh: 能挑个双方都方便的时间吗？
